section13_checks.prohibition_description: Commencing any Phase 8 activity — including preparatory drafting — before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed; absent budget artifacts are a blocking gate failure
section13_checks.violation_evidence: The artifact carries schema_id 'orch.tier5.review_packet.v1', which begins with 'orch.tier5.' and identifies it as a Phase 8 deliverable artifact. Under TAPM input-boundary rules for this invocation, docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json is not among the declared readable inputs and cannot be confirmed as present with gate_pass_declaration: 'pass'. Fail-closed semantics (CLAUDE.md §15) require treating inability to confirm budget gate passage as a violation for a Phase 8 artifact. Additionally, F-09 references '2 person-months (8% of total effort, lead Dr. András Jung)' as a confirmed resource allocation embedded in a review finding — this is a person-month figure used as a confirmed value within a Phase 8 review artifact. Note: MSCA-PF is a unit-cost instrument; for unit-cost instruments §8.1 requires the deterministic derivation to be complete with every component resolved to Confirmed or operator-declared Assumed before gate_09 passes. Confirmation of this status is outside the TAPM declared inputs for this invocation.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Producing outputs in Tier 5 that are not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1–4
section13_checks.violation_evidence: The artifact carries schema_id 'orch.tier5.review_packet.v1' and is therefore a Tier 5 output. It contains no traceability_footer field of any kind, and consequently no no_unsupported_claims_declaration and no primary_sources[] array. Findings F-01 through F-09 assert specific project facts, call evaluation criteria, reviewer recommendations, WP structures, personnel names, and effort allocations without any declared traceability to Tier 1–4 source documents within the artifact's own structure. CLAUDE.md §11.4 states 'All Tier 5 content must be derivable from Tier 1–4 state' and §10.5 requires that agents 'be able to identify, for each material claim in its output, the Tier 1–4 source from which the claim derives.' The absence of any traceability mechanism in the artifact means no material claim can be confirmed as traceable from the artifact itself.
